So her gross profit is 380,000 minus 295: Don haka ribar da ta samu ya kai 380,000 in banda 295,000, wato naira 85,000.
Now her running costs. Transport 12,000,: Yanzu kudin tafiyarta. Sufuri 12,000, haraji 3,000, jakunkuna 4,000 da kuma bayanan waya naira 3,000.
That is 22,000 naira. So her net profit: Naira 22,000 kenan. Don haka ribar da ta samu ya kai 85,000 a debe 22,000, wato Naira 63,000.
She paid herself 40,000, so 23,000 stays: Ta biya kanta 40,000, don haka 23,000 suka zauna a cikin kasuwancin don bunkasa shi. Idan ba littafin ba, da ta yi hasashe kawai.
Profit is not cash: plan for big payment: Riba ba tsabar kuɗi ba ce: shirya don babban biyan kuɗi
Write SMART goals with a number and a da: Rubuta burin SMART tare da lamba da kwanan wata
Turn your profit goal into a daily targe: Juya makasudin ribarku zuwa manufa ta yau da kullun
Review one hour each month; change one t: Bita awa daya kowane wata; canza abu daya
A profitable business can still run out: Kasuwanci mai riba har yanzu yana iya ƙarewa da tsabar kuɗi, idan kuɗi yana ɗaure a hannun jari ko bashi, ko babban sayayya ya faɗi a cikin sati ɗaya na haya. Don haka duba gaba kowane wata.
Write goals that are specific, measurabl: Rubuta maƙasudai na musamman, masu aunawa, masu iya cimmawa, masu dacewa da ƙayyadaddun lokaci. Wato SMART.
Lami in Kano wants 90,000 naira net prof: Lami a Kano na son ribar Naira 90,000 duk wata. Tana aiki a baya, ta gano tana bukatar kusan naira 22,100 na tallace-tallace a rana. Yanzu ta san burinta.
At the end of each month, spend one hour: A ƙarshen kowane wata, ku ciyar da sa'a ɗaya tare da littafinku. Watan da ke ƙasa da manufa shine bayanai, ba gazawa ba. Nemo dalilin, kuma canza abu ɗaya.
Count stock weekly; first in, first out: Ƙidaya hannun jari kowane mako; na farko, na farko
Credit only with limits, dates and recor: Kiredit kawai tare da iyakoki, kwanakin da bayanai
Business money apart; fixed pay for you: Kudin kasuwanci ban da; tsayayyen biya a gare ku
Record every sale, cost and drawing: Yi rikodin kowane siyarwa, farashi da zane
To remember. Count stock weekly and sell: Don tunawa. Ƙidaya hannun jari kowane mako kuma sayar da mafi tsufa da farko. Ba da daraja kawai tare da iyakoki, kwanakin da bayanai. Count your stock twice, a week apart: Ƙididdige hajojin ku sau biyu, tsakanin mako guda
Start a credit page and customer list: Fara shafin kiredit da lissafin abokin ciniki
Keep your record book for seven days: Ajiye littafin rikodinku na kwana bakwai
